errors.text_span: 每个日期都有两个并排绘制的柱状图，一个为浅绿色表示“该全球确诊数量”，另一个为蓝色表示“有关 COVID-19 新闻报道数”
errors.evidence: The figure shows only one set of bar charts (blue-green) representing daily new confirmed cases, and a blue line (not bars) representing news reports. There are no paired bars for news reports.
On 2022-07-01, the confirmed cases are approximately 400,000 (not 200,000), and the news reports are about 2,500 (not 2,000).
On 2022-07-29, the confirmed cases peak at approximately 1,500,000 (not 1,700,000), and the news reports peak at about 5,000 (correct for news reports, but confirmed cases are incorrect).
The description omits the chart's purpose: to show the relationship or trend synchronization between daily new confirmed cases and media coverage over time.
The description fails to mention the blue line representing news reports, instead incorrectly describing it as a bar. The reference highlights this as a key visual feature.
The description does not mention the legend, which clarifies the meaning of the bar and line colors.
The description omits the observation of synchronization or lag between the two trends, which the reference emphasizes as a key insight.

errors.text_span: 此图表展示了 2022 年 7 月至 2022 年 8 月期间，该全球确诊病例数与有关 COVID-19 的新闻报道的计数之间的变化
errors.evidence: The phrase '该全球确诊病例数' is awkward and unclear. A clearer phrasing would be '全球每日新增确诊病例数'.

errors.text_span: 柱子高度波动相当大，显示出数量的变化
errors.evidence: The description is overly vague. The reference provides specific insights about synchronization and lag, which are more informative.
The figure is not a grouped bar chart; it uses bars for confirmed cases and a line for news reports. This is a structural misrepresentation.
